entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`chapterUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `chapterName` TEXT NOT NULL, `parentUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `parentTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `parentImageUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `source` TEXT NOT NULL, `timestamp` INTEGER NOT NULL, `supabase_id` TEXT DEFAULT '', `created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_deleted` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_dirty` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`chapterUrl`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`chapterName` TEXT NOT NULL, `parentTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`bookmarked_chapters`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_bookmarked_chapters_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `bookmarked_chapters` BEGIN DELETE FROM `bookmarked_chapters_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_bookmarked_chapters_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `bookmarked_chapters` BEGIN DELETE FROM `bookmarked_chapters_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_bookmarked_chapters_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `bookmarked_chapters` BEGIN INSERT INTO `bookmarked_chapters_fts`(`docid`, `chapterName`, `parentTitle`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`chapterName`, NEW.`parentTitle`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_bookmarked_chapters_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `bookmarked_chapters` BEGIN INSERT INTO `bookmarked_chapters_fts`(`docid`, `chapterName`, `parentTitle`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`chapterName`, NEW.`parentTitle`); END
